mapper.select: SELECT u.*,ui.*,r.*,f.*,p."FEED_NO",p."USER_NO" AS "POST_USER_NO" FROM "FOLLOW" f INNER JOIN "USER" u ON u."USER_NO" = f."USER_FOLLOWING" LEFT JOIN "USER_IMG" ui USING ("USER_NO") LEFT JOIN "USER_ROLE" USING ("USER_NO") LEFT JOIN "ROLE" r USING ("ROLE_NO") LEFT JOIN "POST" p ON p."USER_NO" = u."USER_NO" WHERE u."USER_ID"=#{username}

SELECT u.*, ui."FILE_NO" AS "PROFILE_FILE_NO", ui."FILE_NAME" AS "PROFILE_FILE_NAME", ui."ORI_NAME" AS "PROFILE_ORI_NAME", r.* FROM "FOLLOW" f INNER JOIN "USER" u ON u."USER_NO" = f."USER_FOLLOWING" LEFT JOIN "USER_IMG" ui USING ("USER_NO") LEFT JOIN "USER_ROLE" USING ("USER_NO") LEFT JOIN "ROLE" r USING ("ROLE_NO") WHERE f."USER_FOLLOWER" = #{userNo}

SELECT u.*, ui."FILE_NO" AS "PROFILE_FILE_NO", ui."FILE_NAME" AS "PROFILE_FILE_NAME", ui."ORI_NAME" AS "PROFILE_ORI_NAME", r.* FROM "FOLLOW" f INNER JOIN "USER" u ON u."USER_NO" = f."USER_FOLLOWER" LEFT JOIN "USER_IMG" ui USING ("USER_NO") LEFT JOIN "USER_ROLE" USING ("USER_NO") LEFT JOIN "ROLE" r USING ("ROLE_NO") WHERE f."USER_FOLLOWING" = #{userNo}

SELECT u.*, ui."FILE_NO" AS "PROFILE_FILE_NO", ui."FILE_NAME" AS "PROFILE_FILE_NAME", ui."ORI_NAME" AS "PROFILE_ORI_NAME", r.* FROM "FOLLOW" f INNER JOIN "USER" u ON u."USER_NO" = f."USER_FOLLOWING" LEFT JOIN "USER_IMG" ui USING ("USER_NO") LEFT JOIN "USER_ROLE" USING ("USER_NO") LEFT JOIN "ROLE" r USING ("ROLE_NO") WHERE f."USER_FOLLOWER" = #{userNo} AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM "FOLLOW" f2 WHERE f2."USER_FOLLOWER" = f."USER_FOLLOWING" AND f2."USER_FOLLOWING" = #{userNo} )
